C57BL/c2J albino mice have a lower gain for activation and slower recovery of function following photobleach than does the BALB/cJ albino strain.

the mechanisms by which albino mice are protected from light-induced retinal degeneration.

the Rpe65-MET450 variant is protective against light-induced photoreceptors degeneration in the mouse.

the MET450 variant in the RPE65 gene may be responsible, at least in part, for the protection from light damage in the albino C57BL/2J-c(2)J mouse strain.
